style.toneOfVoice: Add a touch of magic to your festive decor with our Personalised Christmas Deer Glass Bauble. Featuring a charming reindeer design, this elegant keepsake is perfect for celebrating the season and creating lasting memories. You can personalise this bauble with the below: Line 1 up to 20 characters. Line 2 up to 20 characters. Line 3 up to 15 characters. Please note, all personalisation is case sensitive and will appear as entered. Material of the bauble is glass. Comes ready to hang. Ideal for Christmas. Dimensions(mm): Height: 80. Width: 100. Depth: 80.
